notes.title: The Future of Para-Lax
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, Adventurers!
[/h1]
The Development of Para-Lax has sadly been stagnating for some time, but fear not, for we have now picked up development again! Our vision for Para-Lax stands as clear as ever, and we hope that you will continue supporting us and our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664324/26a6292dd63980439f3d3b14748ddb13d5a9a079.jpg[/img]

[h2]We are thrilled to announce that Para-Lax will get a complete overhaul in terms of graphical design, SFX, Story and core mechanics! [/h2]
Due to the nature of this update, the current version of the game will be a "Nostalgia" version until we feel it appropriate to release the big update. 

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Expansionfly]Twitter[/url] for more updates

Stay tuned,
-The Para-Lax Team
